dieline.layersTitle: What the layers in the file mean

layers.Bleed: Bleed: run the artwork out to this line, past the cut
layers.Safe: Safe area: keep text and logos inside this line
layers.HalfCut: Half-cut through the board (some styles only)

pdf.1: Open it in Illustrator (File › Open), not Place, so the layers are kept.
pdf.2: CutContour, Crease, Bleed and Safe are separate layers — put your artwork on a new layer below CutContour.
pdf.3: Do not edit or delete the dieline layers; the factory makes the cutting die from them.

ai.1: Open directly in Illustrator (File › Open): every path is editable and the CutContour and Crease spot swatches are kept
ai.2: If Illustrator asks about PDF content, continue — this is the same dieline as the PDF, named .ai
ai.3: Put your artwork on a new layer under the dieline and never edit or delete the cut and crease lines

dxf.1: Open it in a CAD program or Illustrator; the units are millimetres.
dxf.2: Import at 1:1 scale, then measure one side against the size you asked for.
dxf.3: Before the die is made, check the cut and crease lines are still told apart after import.

svg.1: Opens in a browser, Illustrator, Inkscape or Figma.
svg.2: Sizes are in millimetres — in Figma, check the scale before placing artwork.
svg.3: Good for previews and mock-ups; use the PDF for print.

studioLibrary.title: {count} box styles in the studio
studioLibrary.body: Every one of these can be designed in the studio now; ordering and the price are confirmed once a factory makes that style.

cosmetics.title: Cream and cosmetics boxes
cosmetics.intro: Box styles for creams, serums, lipsticks and skincare, from standard tuck-end cartons to premium rigid boxes, with windows, hang tabs and inserts that hold the bottle.

soap.title: Soap boxes
soap.intro: Boxes and sleeves for bar soap, handmade soap and gift sets — a window to show the bar, or a belly band for a natural look.

supplements.title: Supplement and medicine boxes
supplements.intro: Boxes for supplements, capsules, medicine and health products, with tamper-evident locks, tear strips and folded leaflets.

food.title: Food boxes
food.intro: Food-grade boxes and trays, from meal boxes and burger clamshells to food trays, paper cups and bowls.

snack.title: Snack boxes
snack.intro: Boxes, pouches and trays for snacks, cookies and popcorn, for the shelf and on the go.

bakery.title: Cake and bakery boxes
bakery.intro: Cake boxes, bread boxes and bakery trays, with windows, handles and locking lids.

beverage.title: Bottle and drink packaging
beverage.intro: Wine boxes, bottle carriers, cup carriers, bottle labels and shippers with cells.

tea_coffee.title: Tea and coffee packaging
tea_coffee.intro: Boxes, flat-bottom pouches, cup sleeves and paper tubes for tea, coffee and brewed drinks.

jewelry.title: Jewellery boxes
jewelry.intro: Rigid boxes, drawer boxes and pillow boxes for rings, necklaces, earrings and watches.

apparel.title: Apparel and shoe boxes
apparel.intro: Mailer boxes, shoe boxes, telescope boxes, paper bags and hang tags for clothing brands.

electronics.title: Electronics boxes
electronics.intro: Boxes for accessories, earphones, cables and gadgets, with hang tabs for pegs and inserts that hold the product.

candle_fragrance.title: Candle and fragrance boxes
candle_fragrance.intro: Boxes for candles, perfume and reed diffusers — hexagonal cartons, paper tubes and shoulder-neck rigid boxes.

produce.title: Fruit and vegetable boxes
produce.intro: Corrugated boxes and trays for fruit, vegetables and farm produce, with vents, hand holes and telescope lids.

gift.title: Gift boxes
gift.intro: Gift boxes in every shape, from pillow, pyramid and petal boxes to rigid boxes with magnetic lids.

luxury.title: Premium boxes
luxury.intro: Rigid and double-wall boxes for premium products, closing with magnets, ribbons or as a book.

retail.title: Retail packaging
retail.intro: Shelf and peg packaging, counter displays and corrugated display stands.

shipping.title: Shipping boxes
shipping.intro: Corrugated boxes for shipping and storage — slotted, overlap, lock-bottom and pallet-size boxes.

ecommerce.title: E-commerce and mailer boxes
ecommerce.intro: Mailer boxes, self-seal boxes and courier bags for online shops.

protection.title: Inserts and protective packaging
protection.intro: Cavity inserts, bottle-neck inserts, partitions and edge protectors that get products there safely.

branding.title: Labels, tags and brand print
branding.intro: Labels, stickers, hang tags, thank-you cards, leaflets and table tents that make the brand stand out.

with-window.title: Boxes with a window
with-window.about: A cut-out that shows the product inside, with or without clear film, on the front or the top.

with-hang-tab.title: Boxes with a hang tab
with-hang-tab.about: A tab for hanging on store pegs — euro slot, round hole or sombrero header.

lock-bottom.title: Lock-bottom boxes
lock-bottom.about: A bottom that locks itself as the box opens and carries more weight than a tuck — crash lock, 1-2-3 snap lock or four-flap lock.

with-handle.title: Boxes with a handle
with-handle.about: A carry handle — die-cut in the board, an inserted handle, or a cord on a bag.

with-hand-holes.title: Boxes with hand holes
with-hand-holes.about: Cut-outs to lift a heavy box by, on the ends or the sides.

with-insert.title: Boxes with an insert
with-insert.about: A die-cut insert that holds the product still, its cavities cut to the product: round, rectangular or bottle-shaped.

magnetic-closure.title: Magnetic closure boxes
magnetic-closure.about: A lid held by magnets hidden in the board — a soft, premium close.

ribbon-closure.title: Ribbon closure boxes
ribbon-closure.about: Tied shut with a ribbon — for gift and premium boxes.

with-zipper.title: Pouches with a zipper
with-zipper.about: A resealable zipper that keeps the contents fresh.

with-tear-strip.title: Boxes with a tear strip
with-tear-strip.about: A strip that opens the box easily and shows at once if it was opened.

self-seal.title: Self-seal boxes
self-seal.about: A built-in adhesive strip that closes the box without tape; a second strip for returns.

with-vents.title: Boxes with vents
with-vents.about: Vent holes that let fruit and vegetables breathe and keep the box dry.

with-thumb-notch.title: Boxes with a thumb notch
with-thumb-notch.about: A notch for a thumb to pull the lid or the drawer.

airplane-tuck.title: Airplane-tuck boxes
airplane-tuck.about: A tuck lid with locking side flaps that closes tighter than a plain tuck.

with-header-card.title: Boxes with a header card
with-header-card.about: A header behind the product for the logo and a promotion.

lock-corner.title: Lock-corner trays and boxes
lock-corner.about: Corners that lock together without glue, set up by hand in the shop.
